tax.text: He said his fiscal goal is to return as much money as possible to taxpayers through budget balancing and spending cuts.
tax.quote: As a fiscal conservative my goal is to bring as much money back to tax payers as possible.

debt.text: He supports cutting federal spending, zero-based budgeting and a balanced-budget amendment to address the national debt.
debt.quote: To fix this, I support zero-based budgeting at the federal level.

schools.text: He strongly agreed with expanding school choice through vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: He said he would fund and expand police departments and punish criminals.
safety.quote: Fund the police and expand police departments. Punish criminals and not victims.

immigration.text: He supports stronger border security and deporting as many people who entered illegally as possible, while also supporting legal immigration and migrant workers.
immigration.quote: We should deport as many illegal entrants as possible, focusing on criminals, recent arrivals, and those who refuse to assimilate.

guns.text: He said no additional gun-ownership restrictions are needed for public safety.
guns.quote: None. Politicians want to punish the 99.999 percent of legal gun owners for the deeds of .001 percent.

abortion.text: He says abortion should be prohibited with limited exceptions, and supports federal policies to uphold pro-life principles.
abortion.quote: Abortion is not a form of healthcare or a casual choice—it is the ending of a human life, and as such, it should be prohibited in all but the most exceptional circumstances.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or occupy women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

energy.text: He rejects urgent action on human-caused climate change and identifies oil and nuclear power as reliable sources that should not be eliminated.
energy.quote: Oil and Nuclear. We will eventually find other sources but we don't need to eliminate any sources today.

voting.text: He supports voter ID and a more stringent voting process.
voting.quote: Require voter ID and a more stringent voting process. We need to keep our elections safe and fair.

tax.text: He voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill and said it would make the 2017 tax cuts permanent.
tax.quote: It restores common sense to Washington by making the Trump tax cuts permanent, securing our borders, stopping taxpayer abuse, and ensuring American energy powers our economy, not foreign adversaries.

trade.text: He said strategic tariffs can protect domestic industries and strengthen supply chains.
trade.quote: Strategic tariffs, when used responsibly, help level the playing field, protect domestic industries, and strengthen supply chains vital to our national security.

debt.text: He pledged to protect Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: I will continue working to strengthen our economy, support our military and veterans, protect Social Security and Medicare, and ensure government remains accountable to the American people.

schools.text: He strongly agreed with expanding school choice through vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: He said he will never support defunding police departments.
safety.quote: As a career law enforcement officer, I will never support "defunding" the police.

immigration.text: He strongly supported doing more to physically secure the southern border.
immigration.quote: The U.S. should do more to physically secure the southern border.

guns.text: He said law-abiding Americans should be able to own any firearms they desire.
guns.quote: The Constitution is clear that law-abiding Americans should be able to own whatever firearms they desire.

abortion.text: He said he believes in the right to life of the unborn and would oppose taxpayer-funded abortions.
abortion.quote: While overturning Roe v. Wade was an important win for the pro-life cause, Mike knows that the fight is not over.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or use women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

energy.text: He said he would lower fuel and other prices by increasing domestic energy production.
energy.quote: He'll fight to lower the prices of gas, groceries, and fertilizer by increasing domestic energy production and bringing critical supply chain jobs back to America from China.

voting.text: He voiced support for the SAVE America Act and said voter ID requirements are important to elections.
voting.quote: I don’t know, I hope we can get that moved out, it’s very important to our elections.

wages.text: He called Mississippi’s $7.25 minimum wage unlivable and called for raising it to $15 or more.
wages.quote: Hulum said the minimum wage in Mississippi of $7.25 is not a livable wage and called for raising it to $15 or more.

schools.text: His campaign supports strong public schools and investing taxpayer dollars in children’s education.
schools.quote: Every child deserves a quality education, no matter their ZIP code. Strong schools build strong communities — investing tax payer dollars in our children is the best investment we can make in our future.

safety.text: His campaign says public safety should go together with fairness, accountability, and rehabilitation.
safety.quote: Our justice system should keep communities safe while ensuring fairness, accountability, and rehabilitation.

health.text: He said access to healthcare should not depend on a person’s job title and described healthcare as a basic necessity.
health.quote: It should not be about our job title. We’re Americans. We pay taxes.

voting.text: His campaign says every Mississippi citizen should have the right and access to participate in the democratic process.
voting.quote: Every citizen of Mississippi deserves the right and access to participate in the democratic process.
